post_su_window.inclusion_rule: Streams starting before the end-exclusive cutoff are included in full.

classification_window.stream_inclusion_rule: Audience and activity results use only streams starting during this August window.

calculation_definitions.weighted_average_viewers: Post-SU hours watched divided by post-SU hours streamed. Hours watched are taken from the source file or calculated as average viewers multiplied by stream hours.
calculation_definitions.simple_average_viewers: Arithmetic mean of the average viewers for each post-SU broadcast.
calculation_definitions.hours_watched: Source hours watched, prorated by post-SU duration share only when a stream crosses the post-SU start boundary.
calculation_definitions.followers_gained: Source followers gained, prorated by post-SU duration share only when a stream crosses the post-SU start boundary.

growth_classification.undetermined: Pre-SU and post-SU stream data are both required to determine audience growth.
growth_classification.grew: More than 10% above June average viewers.
growth_classification.stagnant: Between -10% and 10% of June average viewers.
growth_classification.fell_off: More than 10% below June average viewers.

calculation_definitions.barely_streamed: Fewer than 2 broadcasts or fewer than 20 total streaming hours during August 1 through August 30.
